{{Top|leg}}
'''Emori leatherwork''' was a form of artistic leatherworking, from the [[Emorus system/Legends|Emorus system]],<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the Emori leatherwork|system=[[Emorus system/Legends|Emorus system]]|legends=1}}</ref> in which a geometric network of small cuts and divots was carved into the leather, creating a pattern that flowed across the leather.
